General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Rear Floor Panel for the Gypsy King/Samurai LWB
Complete LWB pan can not be shipped via UPS due to length. (Complete LWB local pickup only) We cut the pan to 38″ which works well for the short wheel base Samurai. Please email if you have any questions.
Please measure carefully as this is not a true drop in for a Samurai, splicing into the front of original pan will be required.
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Panel, Rear Floor
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Gypsy King 1985 – 1995
Suzuki Samurai LWB 1985 – 1995
